messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: Pager — unusual auth traffic detected against prod auth-proxy. 401/403 spike + repeated token introspection failures from 52.23.11.8 and 18.197.5.12. Paging @jess-oncall.

jess-oncall: on it. taking the bridge. can someone post quick impact numbers and a suspected blast radius?

infra-bot: Observability snapshot: https://obs.redwood/internal/dashboards/auth-anomaly?since=15m — 401 rate x14, token-introspect errors x400/min. CPU on auth-proxy +20%.

maya-eng: looking at logs (grep window 10:15-10:30 UTC). seeing many requests carrying header x-svc-token: svc-abc-XXXX. tokens failing introspection with 401/invalid_key. pattern: repeated calls from two IPs and a few different svc tokens.

sam-sec: suspect leaked service key or token replay. immediate actions: 1) rotate service-account keys for svc-auth, 2) revoke active tokens issued in last 2h, 3) block offending IPs. Can we run a targeted revoke now?

liam-sre: prepping firewall deny rules for 52.23.11.8 and 18.197.5.12 — pushing to WAF and infra ACL, ETA ~2m. Also we can add temporary rate-limit rule on auth-proxy: 60r/min per source.

jess-oncall: sam, can you kick off rotation + revoke? maya, preserve those logs and snapshot S3 bucket. nate, check customer impact.

sam-sec: executing playbook: `redwoodctl auth rotate-service-key --service=svc-auth --kms=projects/redwood/kms/keyrings/prod/keys/svc-auth-rot` then `redwoodctl tokens revoke --issued-after="-2h" --service=svc-auth`.

deploy-bot: Starting job #bld-4729: apply-auth-config-change (rate-limit canary) to 3 pods. Canary rollout started.

maya-eng: archived logs to s3://incidents-archive/3155555555/ and exported grep results to /tmp/auth-leak-snippet.log. saved a sample of 10 failing tokens. not including raw tokens in channel — uploaded to secure share.

nate-cs: Customer check: two customers (cust-alpha, cust-gamma) reporting elevated 5xx on auth calls. estimating <0.5% of active sessions affected but those services do rely on realtime token exchange. preparing outreach draft.

olivia-legal: preserve all evidence. do NOT delete logs. If leak confirmed, we need to run the data incident checklist and coordinate customer notification. tagging legal for review once we have confirmation.

liam-sre: WAF rules applied, IPs blocked at edge. auth-proxy rate-limit in place (canary). traffic from blocked IPs dropped. blocking confirmed at 3155555700.

sam-sec: service key rotation started at 3155555680; revoke job kicked off. I'll post when revoke completes. also recommend emergency KMS key-swap and reissue new tokens with short TTL.

jess-oncall: good. Nate — hold on comms until we know whether tokens were exfiltrated or just replayed. Olivia — please hold legal review on notice template, will add details in 30m.

sam-sec: revoke completed at 3155555825 — command returned: 412 tokens revoked. follow-up: creating rotated key `svc-auth-v2` and updating service account. Steps:
- rotate KMS key
- deploy new service key to auth-proxy with secret rotation
- invalidate old key material

maya-eng: quick forensics: some tokens show `user-agent: go-http-client/1.1` and odd sequence of endpoints (introspect -> rerank -> embeddings). suspicious pipeline possibly scraping logs. No evidence yet of S3 exfil. scanning logshipper outbound events.

infra-bot: logshipper outbound queue: no large uploads in last hour; one retry at 3155555600 from shard-7 (investigating). marking for follow-up.

nate-cs: draft comms (internal): "We observed an auth anomaly causing intermittent failures for cust-alpha and cust-gamma. We're actively remediating and will update within 2 hours." Will prepare customer-specific impact once we know extent.

olivia-legal: if tokens were exposed, notify affected customers with remediation steps and offer rotation assistance. preserve chain-of-custody for any artifacts.

deploy-bot: Canary completed on 3 pods at 3155555870. No regressions. rolling to remaining instances.

liam-sre: rolling update applied across auth-proxy fleet at 3155555900. temporary mitigations in place: IP blocks + rate-limits + rotated keys.

jess-oncall: summary action items: 1) sam to confirm KMS key swap and secrets rollout (done/in-progress) 2) maya & infra to finish outbound log scan and preserve artifacts 3) nate to hold comms pending legal 4) postmortem owner assigned (maya). ETA for follow-up update 30m.

sam-sec: KMS swap in prod complete at 3155555910. new key in use; old key disabled. recommend full audit for any systems that accepted old key in last 24h. I'll open a sec ticket with details.

jess-oncall: thanks everyone. keeping channel open for 30m for updates. if anything else critical, page immediately. :thumbsup:
